parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client that is unique across different requests. **ClientToken** supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID. The following regions are supported: China (Qingdao), China (Beijing), China (Zhangjiakou), China (Hohhot), China (Ulanqab), China (Hangzhou), China (Shanghai), China (Shenzhen), China (Heyuan), China (Guangzhou), China (Chengdu), Hong Kong (China), Singapore, Japan (Tokyo), US (Silicon Valley), and US (Virginia).

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the region IDs and other information.
